title: La torre de Uri suena a song-mazmorra-oscuro
description: docs/audio.md: song-mazmorra-oscuro plays in Uri's tower, a long take streamed that comes in from a different point every time on going in and when a fight there ends, and at no other moment: at the end of the file it goes on from the top. Needs --chrome (Playwright's Chromium cannot decode AAC).

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.showMusic = text => { let el = document.querySelector('#music-check'); if (!el) { el = document.createElement('div'); el.id = 'music-check'; el.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;right:16px;top:100px;z-index:9999;padding:10px 14px;background:#101410f2;color:#e8f0e0;font:14px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace;white-space:pre'; document.body.append(el); } el.textContent = text; };

steps.caption: In the tower: song-mazmorra-oscuro, from wherever it came in
After the fight it comes back from somewhere else in the song

steps.eval: window.showMusic(`${window.gerard.music.playing}\nal llegar al final del fichero\nsigue desde el principio: ${window.gerard.music.position().toFixed(0)} s`)

steps.caption: While it plays it never jumps: at the end of the file it goes on from the top
Out of the tower it fades
